source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The landing updates the SDK directory for both macOS builds while retaining different x64 and aarch64 deployment minima. Current configuration uses an even newer SDK but still passes MACOS_TARGET_SDK to -mmacosx-version-min; MACOS_SDK_DIR selects the sysroot. Preserve those separate contracts when updating a toolchain. Acceptance and the configured directory name do not prove the SDK was fetched or the cross-build passed. No toolchain build ran.
title: The libotr SDK version is separate from its minimum macOS target
